title: Wolfenstein SDK mod.json
description: A mod: a list of changes to assets (Decls). See spec/SPEC.md §7.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the mod directory name.

game.description: tno = The New Order, tnc = The New Colossus.

priority.description: Low priorities are applied first; the highest wins.

^[^:]+:.+$.description: Legacy form: asset entries at the top level.

set.description: Decl path -> new value. Order is preserved.

file.description: Path (relative to the mod directory) of a full replacement.
